业务模块分册

这些模块的 Java 源码在 8e80602b875f 中完整存在，但根 POM 与 yudao-server 默认注释其依赖。 启用方式见官方文档；未启用时 DefaultController 对多数前缀返回“已禁用”。

总册 · 平台分册。左侧目录按模块跳转。

计数总表

OA

身份、租户、菜单、文件、任务属于平台分册，本模块通过 API 与 tenant_id 使用它们，并不拥有 system_users。

6菜单页
268HTTP 操作
48H2 测试表
48DO
39测试类

接口

可见 268 / 268
方法路径说明权限类
POST/admin-api/oa/announcement/create创建公告oa:announcement:createOaAnnouncementController.createAnnouncement
DELETE/admin-api/oa/announcement/delete删除发布的公告oa:announcement:deleteOaAnnouncementController.deleteAnnouncement
DELETE/admin-api/oa/announcement/delete-received删除接收的公告需登录OaAnnouncementController.deleteReceivedAnnouncement
POST/admin-api/oa/announcement/forward转发公告给下属需登录OaAnnouncementController.forwardAnnouncement
GET/admin-api/oa/announcement/get获得公告详情oa:announcement:queryOaAnnouncementController.getAnnouncement
GET/admin-api/oa/announcement/published-page获得我发布的公告分页oa:announcement:queryOaAnnouncementController.getPublishedAnnouncementPage
GET/admin-api/oa/announcement/received-page获得接收的公告分页oa:announcement:queryOaAnnouncementController.getReceivedAnnouncementPage
PUT/admin-api/oa/announcement/update更新公告oa:announcement:updateOaAnnouncementController.updateAnnouncement
PUT/admin-api/oa/announcement/update-read-status标记公告为已读需登录OaAnnouncementController.updateAnnouncementReadStatus
POST/admin-api/oa/attendance/clock执行当前用户打卡需登录OaAttendanceController.clockAttendance
DELETE/admin-api/oa/attendance/delete删除考勤记录oa:attendance:deleteOaAttendanceController.deleteAttendance

方法路径说明权限类
GET/admin-api/im/channel/material/get获取素材详情；用于客户端点击图文卡片渲染详情页需登录ImChannelMaterialController.getMaterial

PUT/admin-api/im/group-member/update更新群成员需登录ImGroupMemberController.updateGroupMember
PUT/admin-api/im/group-request/agree同意加群申请（群主或管理员）需登录ImGroupRequestController.agreeGroupRequest
POST/admin-api/im/group-request/apply申请加群需登录ImGroupRequestController.applyJoinGroup

GET/admin-api/im/manager/statistics/user-trend获得用户趋势（新增注册 / 日活双线）im:manager:statistics:queryImStatisticsManagerController.getUserTrend
GET/admin-api/im/message/group/get-read-user-ids获取群消息已读用户列表需登录ImGroupMessageController.getGroupReadUserIds
GET/admin-api/im/message/group/list查询群聊历史消息需登录ImGroupMessageController.getGroupMessageList
GET/admin-api/im/message/group/pull拉取群聊消息（增量）需登录ImGroupMessageController.pullGroupMessageList
PUT/admin-api/im/message/group/read标记群聊消息已读需登录ImGroupMessageController.readGroupMessages
DELETE/admin-api/im/message/group/recall撤回群聊消息需登录ImGroupMessageController.recallGroupMessage
POST/admin-api/im/message/group/send发送群聊消息需登录ImGroupMessageController.sendGroupMessage
GET/admin-api/im/message/private/list查询私聊历史消息需登录ImPrivateMessageController.getPrivateMessageList
GET/admin-api/im/message/private/max-read-message-id查询对方已读到我发的最大消息 id需登录ImPrivateMessageController.getMaxReadMessageId
GET/admin-api/im/message/private/pull拉取私聊消息（增量）需登录ImPrivateMessageController.pullPrivateMessageList
PUT/admin-api/im/message/private/read标记私聊消息已读需登录ImPrivateMessageController.readPrivateMessages
DELETE/admin-api/im/message/private/recall撤回私聊消息需登录ImPrivateMessageController.recallPrivateMessage
POST/admin-api/im/message/private/send发送私聊消息需登录ImPrivateMessageController.sendPrivateMessage
POST/admin-api/im/rtc/accept接听通话需登录ImRtcCallController.accept
POST/admin-api/im/rtc/cancel取消邀请；主叫接通前调用需登录ImRtcCallController.cancel
POST/admin-api/im/rtc/create创建新通话；按 conversationType 区分私聊 / 群聊需登录ImRtcCallController.createCall
GET/admin-api/im/rtc/get-active-call查询当前进行中的通话；用于群聊顶部「N 人正在通话」胶囊条需登录ImRtcCallController.getActiveCall
POST/admin-api/im/rtc/invite通话中追加邀请；仅群通话可用需登录ImRtcCallController.inviteCall
POST/admin-api/im/rtc/join加入已有群通话；用于胶囊条「加入」按钮需登录ImRtcCallController.joinCall
POST/admin-api/im/rtc/leave离开通话；接通后调用需登录ImRtcCallController.leave
POST/admin-api/im/rtc/no-answer-call-check前端 RUNNING 端 timer 兜底；触发后端立即扫描该 room 的振铃超时（接口静默）需登录ImRtcCallController.noAnswerCallCheck
POST/admin-api/im/rtc/reject拒绝通话需登录ImRtcCallController.reject
